NetShort

A fast-growing challenger mixing romance, fantasy and game-like survival stories.

How it works: NetShort is a vertical short drama app. Series are cut into 1–2 minute episodes; the opening episodes are free, and the rest unlock with in-app coins or a subscription. Prices and free-episode counts change often, so check the app page after you tap through.
